WET DISTILLERS GRAINS
WET DISTILLERS GRAINS
Load out hours: Monday - Friday 6:00 a.m. - 10:00 p.m.
Saturday 8:00 a.m.- 2:00 p.m.
Following KDOT rules, 90,000 over-weight permits must be turned into the scale house before loading.
Drivers will follow directory signs upon entering the site while following the speed limit of 10 MPH.
All drivers and passengers must remain within 50ft of their trucks.
All new drivers to the site will go through a safety orientation at the scale house.
Wet Distillers Grains with Soluble (WDGS) are a co-product of the dry mill ethanol process. WDGS are a medium-protein and high-energy ingredient consisting of a grain fraction and whole stillage from the yeast fermentation of grain used to make ethanol.
